note: Read by scripts/check_release.py, which wrangler runs before every deploy of this Worker (build.command in wrangler.jsonc). Whoever deploys re-reads Cloudflare and the other session's ledger first, and adds the commit that is live to required_ancestors in the same change, so a deploy can never build from a branch that lacks it. 8e27a67 is Antigravity's v6.11 handoff (worker kits, bandit, reprioritize, client indexing), merged on top of the light pages.

live_when_recorded.source: c643787 (the pages release; the version before it was daaff3ec, Gemini's 76a428f)

rules: The working tree is clean: deploy a commit that was reviewed, never uncommitted edits.
Every required ancestor is contained in HEAD (the commit that is live now, and the Muse-first release).
The page assets' versions in herma/page_shell.json match the files in herma/static/assets.

No served page, public JSON or text file names the retired model family, the banned word or an agent app; pages use Tasks and Task Objects in prose and carry no receipt or hash wording, even when worker-written text holds them.
make light-check passes (MUST-FOLLOW rule 13): both colour schemes, no dark panel, no dark media query, color-scheme only light.

This local gate cannot stop another checkout or credential holder from bypassing the release process; the release operator re-reads Cloudflare and requires the live version unchanged immediately before deploy.
